def factor_volume_state_transition_carry_smooth(df):
    """Smoothed carry of price movement following transitions into unusually active volume."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    is_high_vol, is_low_vol, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    active = is_high_vol > 0
    prior_active = active.shift(1).fillna(False)
    transition = (active & ~prior_active).astype(float)
    close_return = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    transition_return = transition * close_return
    event_count = transition.rolling(30, min_periods=30).sum()
    carried_return = transition_return.rolling(30, min_periods=30).sum()
    factor = carried_return / (1.0 + event_count)
    df_copy["factor_volume_state_transition_carry_smooth"] = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    return df_copy["factor_volume_state_transition_carry_smooth"]
